IGCC window: order date vs packaging, picking and claim dates

Each row shows how many days pass between two stages of the window. A claim only enters IGCC after picking, so the full window is order to packaging, packaging to picking, then picking to claim. Gaps over 30 days are excluded per stage.

Top items with Day 3+ (gap 2+)

Items claimed on day 3 or later (packaging 2 or more days old)

Day number = gap + 1: Day 1 means the claim happened on the same day (gap 0), Day 2 means one day later (gap 1), and so on. Day 1 is split in two: with dates = same-day gap computed from packaging or picking date; no dates = computed only from the claim-to-order gap because packaging and picking dates were missing. Gap priority: packaging date, then picking date, then claim-to-order. Claims with no computable gap form the No dates bucket. Negative gaps and outliers above 30 days are excluded from gap buckets and count as No dates.
